title: Shield AI Plans $1B Raise for Autonomous X-BAT Fighter Jet
summary: Defense AI startup Shield AI CEO Gary Steele announces plans to raise over $1 billion in early 2027 to fund production of autonomous X-BAT vertical takeoff
body_markdown:
**Officially launched on November 3, 2026.**


#### 💡 TL;DR


- Shield AI CEO Gary Steele announced plans to raise over $1 billion in early 2027 to fund X-BAT autonomous fighter jet production.
- The X-BAT is a vertical takeoff and landing aircraft designed for autonomous flight missions without requiring traditional runways.
- Shield AI raised $2 billion at a $12.7 billion valuation in March 2026 and recently acquired tactical simulation firm Aechelon Technology.


Defense AI startup Shield AI is preparing to raise more than $1 billion to fund production of its X-BAT autonomous fighter jet, CEO Gary Steele announced at the Bloomberg Tech event in London on November 3, 2026. The vertical takeoff and landing aircraft represents the company's latest push into autonomous military aviation technology.


## X-BAT Autonomous Fighter Jet Details


The X-BAT is designed to take off and land vertically without requiring traditional runways, offering significant operational flexibility for military deployments. Steele displayed a model of the craft on stage, highlighting its autonomous flight capabilities that allow the aircraft to operate without human pilots. The system builds on Shield AI's core technology in autonomous flight systems that the company has been developing for US and allied militaries.


The vertical takeoff design eliminates infrastructure requirements that typically constrain fighter jet operations, enabling deployment from ships, forward bases, or unprepared terrain. This capability aligns with modern military doctrine emphasizing distributed operations and rapid response.


## Funding Timeline and Growth Strategy


Officially announced on November 3, 2026, the fundraising effort will likely begin in early 2027, according to Steele. The capital will specifically support production scaling for the X-BAT platform. This follows Shield AI's $2 billion raise in March 2026 at a $12.7 billion valuation, more than doubling the company's worth from the previous year.


Beyond capital raising, Shield AI plans additional acquisitions following its purchase of Aechelon Technology Inc., which develops tactical simulation software for pilot training and autonomous systems testing. Steele emphasized the company focuses on acquisitions that deliver value to military customers, suggesting a strategic approach to inorganic growth.


## Operational Experience in Ukraine


Shield AI has maintained operations in Ukraine for two and a half years with approximately 30 employees on the ground, Steele revealed. The company's systems have been tested in real combat conditions, providing valuable operational data for autonomous flight technology development.


The CEO noted that Shield AI engineered solutions to work around recent restrictions by Elon Musk's Starlink satellite communications service in Ukraine. "We assume that we're always jammed," Steele said, indicating the company designs systems to operate in contested electromagnetic environments where communications can be disrupted or denied.


## Defense AI Investment Surge


Investors are increasingly backing defense startups as governments worldwide expand military budgets in response to rising geopolitical tensions. Shield AI's rapid valuation growth reflects broader market confidence in autonomous military systems and AI-driven defense technology.


- Shield AI raised $2 billion at $12.7 billion valuation in March 2026
- Company acquired Aechelon Technology for tactical simulation capabilities
- X-BAT autonomous fighter features vertical takeoff and landing design
- Shield AI operates with 30 personnel in Ukraine combat zones
- Funding round planned for early 2027 to support X-BAT production


## What This Means


Shield AI's billion-dollar funding plan signals accelerating commercialization of autonomous military aircraft technology. The X-BAT's vertical takeoff capability and autonomous operation represent a significant evolution in unmanned combat systems, potentially reshaping how militaries deploy air power in contested environments. With proven operational experience in Ukraine and strong investor backing, Shield AI is positioning itself as a leader in the defense AI sector at a time when governments are prioritizing autonomous systems procurement.
